Puzzle 1172 Follow up to Puzzle 1171

Problems & Puzzles: Puzzles

Puzzle 1172 Follow up to Puzzle 1171
Paolo Lava sent the following nice puzzle as a follow up to Puzzle 1171

Let p a prime with k digits (d_1, d_2,…,d_k). For any digit, delete it from p. Take the sum of these numbers and check if it is a prime.

Q. Are there chains of 8 or more primes we can get reiterating this process ?

First chains with 7 primes for 17577607, 22977607, 36992723, 65794423, 71564809, 90272807, ...

e.g.

17577607 -> 7577607+1577607+1777607+1757607+1757607+1757707+1757767+1757760 = 19721269 that is prime;

19721269 > 9721269+1721269+1921269+1971269+1972269+1972169+1972129+1972126 = 23223769 that is prime;

23223769 -> 3223769+2223769+2323769+2323769+2322769+2322369+2322379+2322376 = 19384969 that is prime;

19384969 -> 9384969+1384969+1984969+1934969+1938969+1938469+1938499+1938496 = 22444309 that is prime;

22444309 > 2444309+2444309+2244309+2244309+2244309+2244409+2244439+2244430 = 18354823 that is prime;

18354823 > 8354823+1354823+1854823+1834823+1835823+1835423+1835483+1835482 = 20741503 that is prime;

20741503 > 0741503+2741503+2041503+2071503+2074503+2074103+2074153+2074150 = 15892921 that is not prime;

From April 20 to 26, contributions came from Michael Branicky, Simon Cavegn, J-M Rebert, V. F. Izquierdo, Oscar Volpatti

V. F. wrote:

My only contribution to this puzzle is the following: The 1st sum of digits according to condition, gives the results:

NºDígitos 1ª suma

2 a+b

3 20 a+11 b+2 c

4 3 (100 a+40 b+7 c+d)

5 4000 a+1300 b+220 c+31 d+4 e

6 50000 a+14000 b+2300 c+320 d+41 e+5 f

7 3 (200000 a+50000 b c+1100 d+140 e+17 f+2 g)

8 7000000 a+1600000 b+250000 c+34000 d+4300 e+520 f+61 g+7 h

9 80000000 a+17000000 b+2600000 c+350000 d+44000 e+5300 f+620 g+71 h+8 i

It seems that if the number of digits is of the form 3k+1, it cannot be prime.

Oscar wrote:

The first chain of length 8 begins with prime 10727046812081:

10727046812081, prime

15284620515581, prime

24963218402081, prime

37845991221581, prime

57070332504881, prime

80681960501141, prime

106190526261917, prime

160063608146509, prime

278321850240026, composite

Next five chains of length 8 begin with the following primes:

11284486879469,

11392744499569,

11852666446069,

12272852359069,

12298632911069,

I was hoping to find chains of infinite length by detecting periodic loops.

I found some loops with small periods, but containing composites too.

period 1:

1729404, 1729404;

period 2:

1686420, 1713582, 1686420;

period 3:

13968815, 14292656, 14218067, 13968815;

period 4:

119834438, 123355957, 123102491, 122163727, 119834438;

and a few more

Unfortunately, there is no such loop containing only primes ("prime loop"):

no prime loop begins with a prime below 10^11, by exaustive search;

every sequence beginning with a number above 10^11 is strictly increasing, so it can't contain a loop.
